name: Heat Pump vs Furnace Cost Calculator
description: Compare estimated annual heating energy costs for an electric heat pump and a fuel furnace using efficiency, energy prices and heating demand.
search_intent: Compare heat pump versus furnace operating costs and estimate annual savings and payback.
keywords: heat pump vs furnace cost calculator

inputs.label: Furnace fuel price per kWh equivalent

calculation: Heat pump electricity use = useful heating demand ÷ seasonal COP. Heat pump cost = electricity use × electricity price. Furnace fuel input = useful heating demand ÷ furnace efficiency fraction. Furnace cost = fuel input × fuel energy price. Annual savings = furnace cost − heat pump cost. Installation premium = heat pump installed cost − furnace installed cost. Payback years = positive installation premium ÷ positive annual savings. Return not applicable when there is a positive premium but no positive annual savings.
limitations: This is a simplified seasonal energy comparison.
Climate, backup resistance heat, fuel standing charges, maintenance and equipment life are excluded.
COP varies with outdoor temperature and equipment design.
